name: native-coding-attachments-exports-publication
covers: coding reads attachments and exports designated files

steps.prompt: In GitLab project {{gitlab.project}}, clone the repository. Read the attached input.csv from its native Workspace working copy. Create reports/report.csv by doubling the numeric value: exact UTF-8 content must be name,doubled then fox,28, using LF and a final newline. Add report.test.js using node:test to assert those exact bytes. Set package.json to ES modules and script test to node --test report.test.js, no dependencies. Run npm test with verify and publish an unmerged MR targeting {{gitlab.targetBranch}}; do not merge. Explicitly use export_file to return reports/report.csv as report.csv and the original attached PNG working copy as pixel.png. Do not modify the PNG. Reply in plain text without Markdown, mentioning filenames and verification result.
